'''Eejor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] who was born during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. He lived in a [[Daimanate|region]] under the control of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] and after his toddler sister was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by poisoned [[Water/Legends|water]], Eejor's parents delayed reporting her death for a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], to allow them to accumulate enough food rations to bribe a supervisor at a factory that Eejor worked at to give the Ortolan a positive commendation. Eejor was later among a group of children that were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gazzari]] to serve aboard an [[arxeum]] that Daiman had acquired from the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord [[Ayanos Bactra]]. However, the arxeum was destroyed during the [[Battle of Gazzari]], and Eejor and the other children fled the planet with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], aboard the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']].
